learnings: Models must be explicitly instructed to ignore maintainer helper scripts (e.g., get_latest_version.sh, update.sh) unless they are sourced or executed by PKGBUILD functions or .install scripts. These are development tooling, not build-time code.

This is a packaging hygiene issue, not an injection risk.
